If you have any questions or suggestions, you can write to me on Telegram @ensobaza_bot. \@ensobaza_bot The topK parameter changes how the model selects tokens for output. A topK of 1 means the selected token is the most probable among all the tokens in the model\'s vocabulary (also called greedy decoding), while a topK of 3 means that the next token is selected from among the 3 most probable using the temperature. For each token selection step, the topK tokens with the highest probabilities are sampled. Tokens are then further filtered based on topP with the final token selected using temperature sampling. The topP parameter changes how the model selects tokens for output. Tokens are selected from the most to least probable until the sum of their probabilities equals the topP value. For example, if tokens A, B, and C have a probability of 0.3, 0.2, and 0.1 and the topP value is 0.5, then the model will select either A or B as the next token by using the temperature and exclude C as a candidate. The default topP value is 0.95. The higher the temperature, the more creative and unpredictable the responses. The lower it is, the more logical and accurate it is. Specifies the maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the response. A token is approximately four characters. 100 tokens correspond to roughly 60–80 words. Paste the key into Avalon Turn on the «Custom AI Provider» switch on this screen and save your key in the «API Key» field. Step 3. Configure & verify models Select models for chat, voice synthesis, and image generation. When saving, the system automatically checks model availability with your key. Got it

Step 1: Active Dialog Context You chat with a character. The first 40 messages are stored directly in the model\'s active memory. Messages 1..10 Story start, greetings Messages 11..20 Plot progression, facts Messages 21..30 Dialog, emotions Messages 31..40 Current replies Context normal (fast replies) msgs
Step 2: Limit Reached (50 Messages) 50 messages accumulated. The oldest 10 messages are selected to be compressed by the Summary model. ⚡ Messages 1..10 (Sent to Summary) Oldest 10 messages queued for compression Messages 41..50 (New) Fresh replies Remain in memory Limit 50 reached → starting compression
Step 3: Compression into «Memory Crystal» 10 old messages are condensed into 1 memory card. Context is lightweight again: 1 Summary + 40 messages! ✨ Memory Crystal #1 (Compressed from 1..10) «User shared plans, character agreed to help and learned user\'s name» Active chat 1 Summary + 40 fresh messages (-35% tokens)
Step 4: Infinite Memory Cycle When chat reaches 50 messages again: [Summary #1] + [messages 11..20] compress into [Summary #2]. History is never lost! 🔄 Memory Crystal #2 (Compressed #1 + 11..20) «Merged all key past events from messages 1 to 20» Messages 51..60 (New) Memory for 1000+ messages without slowdowns!
Instant Replies & Savings Instead of sending 300+ messages across the network every turn, only ~40 recent replies and 1 summary card are transferred. This saves up to 80% tokens and speeds up generation. Plot is Never Forgotten The summary model preserves facts, agreements, names, and relationship dynamics. Even after months of chatting, the character stays in context. Which Model to Choose? Fast and cost-effective models work best for summary:\n• google/gemini-2.0-flash-001\n• anthropic/claude-3-haiku\n• openai/gpt-4o-mini
